message.reasoning_content: Law 2 = tax 20%. I have no goods left; taxes hurt rivals' sales... but final round 6: rivals sell goods and pay 20% tax to... tax reduces revenue, doesn't go to me. Actually tax harms rivals, not me. So vote yes? But law passes if yes>no. Vote no already from faction 2 (has goods to sell, doesn't want tax). Faction 1 has 2 goods, likely votes no. My yes: 3 vs no 2+? vote_weight: mine 3, theirs 2 each. If I vote yes: 3 vs (2+2)=4 no → fails. If I abstain: yes 0, no fails anyway. Tax on rivals' round 6 sales reduces their cash — good for my rank. So vote yes, but it fails. Alternatively veto not needed. Vote yes is harmless.
